engine.notes: Two theaters split the city: TIM on 4th Avenue leans longform with a 101-501 comedy school, while Unscrewed on East Speedway is the volunteer-run home of family short-form. Live Theatre Workshop teaches improv only to grades 6-12, and Laffs Comedy Caffe is stand-up.

entries.name: Tucson Improv Movement
entries.summary: Tucson's longform-leaning comedy theater and school since 2012: an intimate 40-seat room on 4th Avenue with improv, stand-up and sketch shows every Friday and Saturday and a comedy school running Improv 101 to 501.
entries.schedule: Shows Fri & Sat from 6:30pm; free Improv Jam Fridays 6:30pm; classes 6-8:30pm, six weeks
signals: Improv 101-501 plus stand-up, sketch, teen and youth classes
Fall 2026 starts: Improv 101 Oct 13, 301 Oct 21, 501 Oct 27, 201 Nov 2
The Soap Box, Tucson's longest-running longform team, since 2014
Runs the Tucson Comedy Arts Festival (since 2015) and Cactus Flower Comedy Festival
entries.reasons: Thirteen years, its own theater, a five-level school with dated fall starts, shows every weekend, a free weekly jam and two festivals.

entries.name: Unscrewed Theater
entries.summary: A volunteer-run 501(c)(3) improv theater and the home of Not Burnt Out Just Unscrewed, Tucson's family-friendly short-form troupe founded in 2002, with weekend shows, an eight-week Improv Basics course and a Monday drop-in.
entries.schedule: Family-friendly shows every Fri & Sat 7:30pm; uncensored shows 2nd & 4th Saturdays; drop-in Mondays 6:30pm
signals: Troupe founded May 2002; dedicated venue since January 2014, on Speedway since 2018
Improv Basics: eight weeks, $179, includes a showcase
Fall 2026 Basics start Oct 10 and Oct 14
ImprovBlox six-week courses and one-day BloxShops
Monday drop-in, $10 suggested donation, in person or online
entries.reasons: Two decades of performing, its own theater since 2014, dated fall classes with a path into ImprovBlox and shows every weekend; it is smaller and volunteer-run.
